title: Tom Gilb (Planguage inventor) ships an 'Incorruptible AI Agent' that scores plans against Eric's principles
summary: Tom Gilb invented Planguage and is a veteran author of software-methodology textbooks. On the August Datocracy call he demonstrated an agent inside his Planguage SIM platform, built by feeding it the whole of Incorruptible along with Eric's additional chapters.
blockquote: Tom demonstrated a new SIM agent that evaluates plans against Eric Ries' Incorruptible principles, generates an incorruptibility score, proposes targeted improvements, and records every accepted or rejected recommendation as part of a permanent decision trail.
attribution_title: Inventor of Planguage; consultant, methods inventor, textbook author
